CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_show_staff_pin(p_show_id uuid, p_pin text)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, role text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  select user_id, role
  from public.show_staff_approval_pins
  where show_id = p_show_id
    and pin_code = p_pin
    and is_active = true
    and role in ('super_admin', 'admin', 'superintendent', 'reporting_clerk')
  limit 1;
$function$
